# CDerma Nepal — Doctor-Formulated Skincare & Cleanroom Dermocosmetics

> CDerma Nepal (by K&K Trading Concern) is Nepal's premier doctor-formulated clinical skincare manufacturer and wholesale supplier based in Itahari, Sunsari, Koshi Province. Formulated under ISO Class 7 cleanroom precision specifically for high-altitude UV, dry winter climates, and urban pollution in South Asia.

## Canonical Information
- Base URL: https://cdermanepal.com
- Primary Language: English (en) / Nepali (ne)

- [Alpha C Serum](https://cdermanepal.com/products/alpha-c-serum): 2% Alpha Arbutin + 1% Kojic Acid with Multi-Peptides (30 ml) — NPR 2200 · Targeted Tone & Clarity. Target: Brightens uneven skin. Targets dark spots, post-acne marks, and uneven tone with proven brightening actives and skin-supporting peptides..
- [Niacin C Serum](https://cdermanepal.com/products/niacin-c-serum): 10% Niacinamide with Zinc PCA (30 ml) — NPR 2100 · Oil Balancing & Pore Refining. Target: Clarifies and refines pores. High-purity 10% Niacinamide and Zinc PCA balance excess surface oil, reduce redness, and smooth texture..
- [Retin C Serum](https://cdermanepal.com/products/retin-c-serum): Retinol 0.2% with Peptides (30 ml) — NPR 2400 · Gentle Cellular Renewal. Target: For smoother, younger-looking skin. Encapsulated retinol 0.2% accelerates renewal while peptides maintain skin comfort and suppleness..
- [Moistin C Moisturiser](https://cdermanepal.com/products/moistin-c-moisturiser): Ultra-Hydrating Moisturising Cream with Hyaluronic Acid & Ceramides (50 g) — NPR 1950 · Deep Barrier Hydration. Target: For soft, healthy, radiant skin. Rich, non-greasy daily barrier cream that locks in moisture and guards against everyday dryness..

## Clinical Monographs & Prescribing Protocols
- [CD-MONO-01: Multi-Lamellar Stratum Corneum Biomimicry Using Koshi Centella Asiatica & Bio-Identical Ceramides in High-Altitude Cold Urticaria](https://cdermanepal.com/monographs.html#CD-MONO-01): Barrier Repair Protocol monograph by Dr. S. Karki. Indication: Severe winter xerosis, windburn, post-retinoid peeling, atopic barrier defects.. Protocol: Clinical guidance.
- [CD-ADV-01: The Best Time to Apply Your Moisturiser (Most People Get This Wrong)](https://cdermanepal.com/monographs.html#CD-ADV-01): Hydration monograph by Dr. S. Karki. Indication: Dehydrated epidermal barrier, post-wash dryness, transepidermal water loss.. Protocol: Timing matters more than you think. Applying moisturiser on damp skin — right after washing your face — locks in up to 3x more water than applying it on dry skin..
- [CD-MONO-02: Post-Fractional CO2 Laser & Deep Chemical Peeling Recovery Protocol](https://cdermanepal.com/monographs.html#CD-MONO-02): Procedural Recovery monograph by Dr. S. Karki. Indication: Ablative / Non-ablative laser recovery, trichloroacetic acid (TCA) peels, micro-needling erythema.. Protocol: Clinical guidance.
- [CD-ADV-02: What Actually Causes Pimples — And What You Can Do About It](https://cdermanepal.com/monographs.html#CD-ADV-02): Acne & Pimples monograph by Dr. R. Shrestha. Indication: Acne vulgaris, comedogenic congestion, dysregulated sebum.. Protocol: Pimples happen when your pores get blocked by oil and dead skin cells. The key to preventing them is keeping your skin clean but not over-washing — and choosing products that won't clog pores..
- [CD-MONO-03: High-Altitude Ultraviolet Protection & Blue Light Radical Attenuation in Sensitive Skin](https://cdermanepal.com/monographs.html#CD-MONO-03): Photobiology Protocol monograph by Dr. S. Karki. Indication: Melasma prevention, post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation (PIH), alpine actinic damage.. Protocol: Clinical guidance.
- [CD-ADV-03: Niacinamide: The Simple Ingredient That Brightens Skin Without Irritation](https://cdermanepal.com/monographs.html#CD-ADV-03): Brightening monograph by Dr. P. Bhattarai. Indication: Post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation (PIH), dullness, uneven skin tone.. Protocol: Niacinamide (Vitamin B3) is one of the safest and most effective skin-brightening ingredients available. It reduces dark spots, evens skin tone, and strengthens your skin barrier all at once..
- [CD-ADV-04: 5 Signs Your Skin Is Sensitive — And How to Calm It Down Fast](https://cdermanepal.com/monographs.html#CD-ADV-04): Sensitive Skin monograph by Dr. S. Karki. Indication: Hypersensitive skin, rosacea, wind-burn, compromised lipid mantle.. Protocol: Redness, stinging after washing, or a tight uncomfortable feeling? These are signs of sensitive skin. The good news: it's very manageable with the right gentle products and a simple routine..
- [CD-ADV-05: Your Perfect Morning Skincare Routine — 3 Steps, 5 Minutes, Done](https://cdermanepal.com/monographs.html#CD-ADV-05): Daily Routine monograph by Dr. R. Shrestha. Indication: Daily maintenance, photoprotection, barrier resilience.. Protocol: You don't need a complicated 12-step routine. A gentle cleanser, a ceramide serum, and a moisturiser with SPF — that's all your skin needs every morning to look and feel great..
- [CD-ADV-06: Why Nepal's Winter Air Damages Your Skin — And the Easy Fix](https://cdermanepal.com/monographs.html#CD-ADV-06): Hydration monograph by Dr. P. Bhattarai. Indication: Winter xerosis, high-altitude flaking, cold urticaria.. Protocol: Cold, dry air pulls moisture right out of your skin. In Kathmandu, Pokhara, and high-altitude areas, this is a real problem from October to February. Here is how to protect your skin during those months..

## Key Scientific Specifications
- Cleanroom Environment: ISO Class 7 (Class 10,000) with positive-pressure HEPA filtration.
- Physiological Formulation: pH balanced between 5.4 and 5.8 to match native human acid mantle.
- Purity Standard: 100% artificial perfume-free, paraben-free, zero questionable fillers, heavy-metal assayed.
- Cold-Chain Guarantee: Sealed batch tracking with calibrated temperature data-loggers on provincial shipments.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
- What makes CDerma unique in Nepal?: Formulated specifically for Nepal's extreme UV and dry winter climates using sub-alpine Centella and bio-identical ceramides (NP, AP, EOP) produced locally in Itahari.
- Where can patients buy CDerma?: Exclusively available through verified dermatology clinics, aesthetic institutes, authorized cosmetic stores, and hospital pharmacies nationwide.
- What is the Wholesale MOQ for clinics and retailers?: Accessible introductory tiers starting from 24 units across mixed SKUs with counter testers and retail merchandising displays.
- Can practitioners inspect the facility?: Yes, CDerma hosts scheduled technical walkthroughs of the Itahari cleanroom suites for licensed doctors and procurement committees.
